class.name: JarSignedDistanceField
class.brief_description: Abstract base class for all signed distance field (SDF) primitives.
class.description: This is an abstract [Resource]-derived class that defines the interface and shared behavior for SDF (signed distance field) primitives. All concrete SDF types such as boxes, spheres, planes, and procedural shapes like planets should inherit from this class. It cannot be used directly.

method.name: get_bounds
method.description: Returns the local-space box enclosing the solid part of the field, or an empty [AABB] if it is unbounded (see [method is_bounded]).

method.name: is_bounded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the solid part is finite. Only bounded fields can be used with [method JarVoxelVolume.edit].

method.name: sample
method.description: Evaluates the signed distance field at [param position]. Returns a negative value inside the surface, a positive value outside, and [code]0.0[/code] on the surface — useful from scripts, e.g. to check whether a point is underground.

method.name: sample_normal
method.description: Returns the surface normal (normalized distance gradient) at [param position], in local space.
